description: This Java class defines the OrderProductAttribute entity for the shopping cart/order system, mapping to the 'ORDER_PRODUCT_ATTRIBUTE' table. It models attributes associated with a product in an order, including details such as price, weight, and related options and values.

classes.name: OrderProductAttribute
classes.description: Entity representing an attribute of a product within an order, including pricing, weight, and associated options/values.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of this attribute.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID for this attribute.

methods.name: isProductAttributeIsFree
methods.description: Checks if the attribute is free.

methods.name: setProductAttributeIsFree
methods.description: Sets whether the attribute is free.

methods.name: getProductAttributeWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight of the attribute.

methods.name: setProductAttributeWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight of the attribute.

methods.name: setOrderProduct
methods.description: Associates this attribute with an OrderProduct.

methods.name: getProductAttributeName
methods.description: Returns the name of the attribute.

methods.name: getProductAttributeValueName
methods.description: Returns the value name of the attribute.

methods.name: getProductAttributePrice
methods.description: Returns the price of the attribute.

methods.name: setProductAttributePrice
methods.description: Sets the price of the attribute.

methods.name: getProductOptionValueId
methods.description: Returns the product option value ID.

methods.name: setProductOptionValueId
methods.description: Sets the product option value ID.
